summary: TerraScope is a research prototype built for NASA Space Apps. It explores real NASA POWER observations from five Indian locations, covering eight environmental variables across 2001-2025. That adds up to 1,500 monthly records and 200 tested annual and seasonal trends. Users can explore a map, time series, regional rankings and an automatic “contrast engine” that finds places with opposing trends. Trends are measured with Sen’s slope and tested with Mann-Kendall, with Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery correction (q < 0.05). The site stresses its limits: these are five point samples, not an India-wide map, the tests assume independent annual values, and trends do not prove causes. Results are downloadable as CSV.
